components.label: 02-cluster
components.sublabel: EKS cluster · Auto Mode · node groups

cards.title: Why split by change frequency
items: The network layer changes quarterly at most, so it should not be replanned on every deploy
Cluster-level changes land monthly, usually version upgrades and node group edits
Platform add-ons and RBAC change weekly and benefit from a small, fast plan

cards.title: Blast radius
items: A separate state file per layer means a mistake in one layer cannot destroy the others
terraform plan stays small enough to read, so reviews catch real changes
Apply times shrink from tens of minutes to a couple of minutes for the top layer

cards.title: State layout
items: One S3 bucket holds all three state files under distinct prefixes
Use S3 native locking (use_lockfile = true) rather than a DynamoDB table
Enable versioning on the bucket so a corrupted state can be rolled back
